  SELECT 
    ds.sku,
    SUM(ds.units_sold) AS total_units,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) AS total_revenue

  SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.facings,
    p.depth_cm,
    (p.facings * p.depth_cm * 1.0) AS shelf_cm2,
    (p.facings * p.depth_cm * 1.0) / 929.03 AS shelf_sqft  -- 1 sq ft = 929.03 cm2
  FROM store.products p
)
SELECT 
  s.sku,
  p.name,
  js.total_revenue,
  ss.shelf_sqft,
  (js.total_revenue / ss.shelf_sqft) AS revenue_per_sqft
FROM june_sales js
JOIN shelf_space ss ON js.sku = ss.sku
JOIN store.products p ON js.sku = p.sku
WHERE ss.shelf_sqft > 0
ORDER BY revenue_per_sqft DESC
LIMIT 10;
